disposition_semantics.cleared_with_evidence: Retain only within the scope stated by the corresponding ledger evidence.
disposition_semantics.replaced_with_cleared_asset: The shipped output must point to a documented replacement and its source/output hashes.
disposition_semantics.excluded_from_public_package: Do not include in a publishable build. A file may still be physically present in this review package only because the entire package is explicitly do_not_publish.

decisions.blocking_dependency: per-component provider, source, and redistribution evidence or cleared replacement
official-register trademark result and qualified legal review; preliminary public search and plain-language review are recorded but are not clearance
AR-002 through AR-005 clearance or cleared replacement
verified source-generation provenance and rights or cleared replacement
verified per-raster provider/license mapping or cleared basemap replacement
attribute any newly identified embedded photography before release
permission required before adding any case image, logo, or screenshot
per-component provider/model/batch/input-rights/output mapping or cleared replacement

release_actions.action: Keep the current package marked do_not_publish while excluded files and embedded components remain physically present.
release_actions.acceptance: No publishable manifest or release archive contains an asset group with excluded_from_public_package disposition.

release_actions.action: Replace base-map and satellite pixels with a redistribution-safe source, recording provider, license, capture/version, source hash, transformation, and output hash.
release_actions.acceptance: AR-010 is changed only after evidence exists; downstream AR-002/003/004/006/007 hashes are regenerated.

release_actions.action: Map every retained generated component to provider, model, batch/run, source/input rights, source hash, and output hash, or replace/remove it.
release_actions.acceptance: No retained generated component remains at unknown provenance strength.

release_actions.action: Complete trademark and international-semantics review before treating the working name or logo direction as a public brand asset.
release_actions.acceptance: The reviewer role and decision evidence are recorded without implying registration or endorsement.

summary.claim_boundary: The package-level exclusion is an explicit review boundary, not proof that excluded bytes have already been removed.
